authority: PR #795 round 5, lead decision N2 (2026-11-22): the frozen admission-closure suite stays the acceptance. Only its driver and invocation shim change, so that it calls the executor through the fixed layout the audit-2 ruling requires (no caller path option); every case's data and expected decision stay byte-identical, and all 101,889 cases must run and pass.
what: Arena writes each case's custody at the copy's registered root (<root>/<span id>) and the roster and verdicts at their fixed names (<root>/lm-interim-01/), and runs a committed 'stage1' with no option. Before each invocation it clears stage 1's two fixed outputs and does the lead's pin fill for custody as it then is: the manifest's one pin list from the rostered spans' bytes, a RUN_STATE Check item naming each span's offload manifest in full hex, the LOOKS row naming the manifest's new sha256, committed and published to the copy's origin as one commit on the registration commit, so each case is its own committed look and no earlier case's pin list stays in the ledger history the executor reads. actor no longer memoizes verify_pins, require_inputs_committed or ledger_gate, because each case commits its own pin list (only the immutable code inventory stays memoized), it attributes a pinned stream that the pin guard opens to the reader that asked, and it observes each open the pin guard answers itself (an absent roster file is refused before any open) as the open audit event observed every attempt before the guard existed. case_source_sha256 is ACC.case_source_sha256 of the adopted module (git e6ec842bb), equal for the adapted one. The RL-217 E.1 fix-1 fixture shim generates a stock receipt for each planted verdict and its committed row. It preserves the case source, data, expected decisions and observation hooks.
